mapper.select: SELECT ips.id record_id ,ips.security_code ,ips.security_short_name ,ips.security_type ,si.issuer_code ,si.issuer issuer_name ,ips.target_pool_id ,ips.target_pool_name ,ips.adjust_mode ,ips.audit_time FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = ips.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' LEFT JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = ips.security_code WHERE ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.target_pool_id = #{bondPoolId} AND ips.security_type != 'crmw' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status company_status INNER JOIN dict_security_type company_type ON company_type.security_type = company_status.security_type AND company_type.is_deleted = 0 AND company_type.category_type = 'company' WHERE company_status.is_deleted = 0 AND company_status.audit_status = '20' AND company_status.target_pool_id = #{companyPoolId} AND company_status.security_code = si.issuer_code ) ORDER BY ips.security_code ASC ,ips.id ASC
